# Version 4.157.1 (Unreleased)
> **Vulkan allocation failure handling**

## Highlights

The 4.157.1 servicing changes avoid unsafe Vulkan descriptor-pool destruction after allocation failures on Imagination drivers.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Imagination Vulkan allocation failures** — Ganesh and Graphite deliberately abandon affected descriptor pools after host or device out-of-memory errors instead of destroying pools that may trigger a driver failure. Graphite also rejects further allocations through the abandoned handle. This vendor-specific workaround trades pool cleanup for safety; managed bindings are unchanged. ([#5838](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5838))
